title: Tech Note: 4D Migrating from HTTP to HTTPS
author: Sofia BACKEIKH, Quality Support Engineer, 4D Morocco

historical_commentary.text: This is a general HTTPS/TLS educational overview plus basic 4D configuration steps; the concepts (TLS handshake, certificate types, HTTPS adoption rationale) and the 4D-side steps (cert.pem/key.pem placement, enabling HTTPS in Database Settings) remain accurate and current.
related_updates: 4D's TLS/HTTPS configuration approach for the Web Server is unchanged since this note
General web security best practice has only reinforced HTTPS-by-default since 2019, e.g. broader browser warnings and HSTS adoption
